# API reference

Every public item of the prelude, which every module sees, and of the `std` modules a program can `use`: its signature, its authority, whether it runs, and what it does. It is generated from the sources the checker reads, so it says what the checker accepts. `oskac doc` prints the same reference offline.

All of it is in [api.json](https://oskalang.dev/api.json) as data.

- [prelude](https://oskalang.dev/api/prelude.md): The prelude: what every module sees without `use`.
- [std.sql](https://oskalang.dev/api/std-sql.md): The SQL sink. See <b>this</b>.

---

Source: https://oskalang.dev/api/prelude.html

# prelude

The prelude: what every module sees without `use`.

A second paragraph, which the index leaves out.

`oskac doc prelude` prints this page offline.

## Eq for Option<T>

**Kind:** impl · **Authority:** pure

```oska
impl<T> Eq for Option<T>
```

Hostile: <script>alert(1)</script>, [a link](javascript:alert(1)), ``a `tick` span``, "quotes", a back\slash, Ab< / a slash,	and a tab.

\# Not a heading

```
an open fence <b>bold</b>
## nor this
```

## List.push

**Kind:** method · **Authority:** pure

```oska
pub fn push(var self, item: T)
```

Add `item` at the end.

## String.to_lowercase

**Kind:** method · **Authority:** pure

```oska
pub fn to_lowercase(self) -> String
```

Every letter in lower case: `"ÀB".to_lowercase()` is `"àb"`.

---

Source: https://oskalang.dev/api/std-sql.html

# std.sql

The SQL sink. See <b>this</b>.

> **Checks but does not run.** `oskac check` accepts a program that uses this, but `oskac run`, `oskac test` and `oskac build` refuse it. See [What works today](/guide/what-works-today.md).

`oskac doc std.sql` prints this page offline.

## connect

**Kind:** fn · **Authority:** NetConnect (net)

```oska
pub fn connect(net: NetConnect, url: String) -> Result<Db, SqlError>
```

> **Checks but does not run.** `oskac check` accepts a program that uses this, but `oskac run`, `oskac test` and `oskac build` refuse it. See [What works today](/guide/what-works-today.md).

Connect to the database at `url`.

## Db.\*query\*

**Kind:** method · **Authority:** <img src=x onerror=alert(1)> \_em\_ \`tick\`

~~~oska
```</code></pre><script>alert(1)</script>
~~~

> **Checks but does not run.** `oskac check` accepts a program that uses this, but `oskac run`, `oskac test` and `oskac build` refuse it. See [What works today](/guide/what-works-today.md).
